title: FancyZones Editor reports incorrect resolution with 5 monitors of similar but different sizes
author: SQLXL
summary: FancyZones Editor reports a 7680×2206 combined desktop for a five-monitor arrangement whose expected bounding height is 2160.
next_action: Recreate the topology and compare raw monitor rectangles, work areas, scaling, and editor normalization.

confidence.rationale: The arithmetic discrepancy is clear, but the missing raw topology determines whether it is a defect.

judgment.rationale: The report supplies monitor sizes, the observed and expected aggregate dimensions, and a PDF of the editor; the remaining work is a current topology reproduction.
evidence: The center monitor is 3840×2160 and four flanking displays are 1920×1080 in portrait orientation.
The discrepancy is 46 pixels in the combined vertical dimension.
judgment.recommended_action: Recreate the topology and compare raw monitor rectangles, work areas, scaling, and editor normalization.

fix_assessment.rationale: The public report does not include scaling percentages, taskbar/work-area placement, or current raw monitor coordinates needed to choose a geometry fix.

issue_context.summary: FancyZones Editor reports a 7680×2206 combined desktop for a five-monitor arrangement whose expected bounding height is 2160.
known_information: Five monitors of similar but different sizes are involved.
The reporter expected either one exact combined canvas or individual monitor selection.
inferences: The 46-pixel difference may come from work-area, scaling, or coordinate normalization rather than physical resolution alone.
issue_context.analysis: This is already maintainer-reproducible with equivalent hardware or synthetic monitor rectangles; reporter follow-up is not required before that pass.
initial_investigation: Read the topology and attached-PDF description.
Confirmed current FancyZones has EditorParameters and monitor/layout geometry code used to launch the editor.

actions.label: Reproduce five-monitor editor bounds
actions.note: Maintainer-side verification only; this artifact performs no upstream write.

reproduce.title: Compare FancyZones Editor canvas with monitor rectangles
prerequisites: Five-monitor or virtual-display topology matching the report
setup: Arrange one 3840×2160 center display with four portrait 1920×1080 displays.
Record resolution, scaling, orientation, taskbar edge, and raw monitor/work-area rectangles.
steps: Compare against the union of monitor rectangles and the union of work areas.
Change scaling or taskbar placement one variable at a time.
reproduce.expected_result: The editor canvas should use a documented coordinate basis and match the corresponding monitor union without unexplained pixels.
